batch2.selection: At the final manifest, every incomplete tile whose required states are a subset of the already prepared Batch-1 states plus this coherent central/eastern cohort; includes 30 boundary tiles with no state above the planner's 5% source threshold. The next pass must rerun the planner after preparation and freeze its exact tile list before building.

batch3.selection: Every other tile incomplete at the final Batch-1 manifest, primarily Northeast, southern Plains/Texas, northern Plains, New Mexico, Nevada and Utah. Re-derive after Batch 2; this is not authorization to execute it.

concurrencyRecommendation.design: At most two concurrent DEM downloads/local raster builds; serialize SDA and other hosted-service requests, R2 publication, manifest mutation and checkpoints.
concurrencyRecommendation.reason: The measured median tile path is dominated by DEM at 66.0 seconds. Median local habitat is 1.4 seconds, median access is 2.8 seconds, and remote publication is 12.7 seconds across phases. Batch 1 observed only about 0.49 GB additional DEM cache and a 4.90 GB peak volume-use swing, but hosted services had a real 500-retry incident.
